subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core Control UI editable dictation workflow through a new `audio.transcribe` operator-write Gateway method after this branch is rebased and proven?
rationale: The patch adds a new user-facing microphone path plus provider-backed transcription and temporary audio handling, which is a product and privacy boundary that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Accept Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
options.body: Keep the provider-backed direction, but require the rebase, accessibility fix, docs-map update, green docs check, and redacted successful dictation proof before merge.

options.title: Defer behind broader voice work
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader WebChat STT/TTS provider direction settles a shared voice boundary.

options.title: Decline core dictation for now
options.body: Close or supersede the PR if maintainers do not want editable dictation in the core Control UI surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-backed direction, but require the rebase, accessibility fix, docs-map update, green docs check, and redacted successful dictation proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged server-side dictation history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the Gateway-backed voice boundary decision.
